rationale: EXECUTED matrix: default git auto-merges disjoint-key same-record edits into valid JSON (one verb pair verified), overlapping keys conflict, union corrupts a record and silently drops an aggregate entry, -X drops a side, -merge regresses clean disjoint merges to human conflicts. Publishing 'any clean merge is safe' on one executed pair would invite the field to widen tier-A on an unverified claim.
